## Welcome

I'm a graduate of **UCD's Economics & Politics** programme, currently pursuing an **MSc in Business Analytics** at Dublin City University. I'm passionate about data analytics, cybersecurity, and using technology to solve real-world problems.

Multilingual (Russian · English · French), technically proficient, and always looking to grow - I'm building towards a career at the intersection of data and digital security.
